thread:
elaine: heads-up — customer on Dedicated reporting 404s after upgrading to @redwood/sdk@0.23. embeddings call returns 404 'route not found'. Repro steps below.

elaine: code:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = new Redwood();
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: 'hello' });
```

elaine: error: 404 POST /v1/embeddings.create -> { error: 'route not found' }

sam: what exact package version? node/runtime? can you curl the API directly to confirm path? @eng-sdk

elaine: package.json: "@redwood/sdk": "0.23.0"
elaine: node v18.16
elaine: curl:
```bash
curl -s -i -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/embeddings.create \  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \  -d '{"input":"hello","model":"rwd-embed-1"}'
# -> 404 Not Found
```

mike: this looks like SDK is emitting dot-qualified route names (embeddings.create). API expects /v1/embeddings (not dot). I think 0.23 changed the client method mapping. Quick workaround: call the raw endpoint or downgrade to 0.22.

support-oncall: customer is enterprise Dedicated (acct: ACCT-824). P2 impact — they have production traffic. Need a short-term mitigation and ETA for fix.

sam: temporary workaround (curl/raw fetch):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/embeddings \  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \  -d '{"input":"hello","model":"rwd-embed-1"}'
```

sam: or in node:
```js
await fetch('https://api.redwood.test/v1/embeddings', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'hello', model: 'rwd-embed-1' }),
});
```

mike: I created branch fix/sdk-route-normalize that adds a compatibility shim mapping embeddings.create -> embeddings and chat.create -> chat/completions. I'll open PR and get a canary. @deploy-bot can you run a canary on staging?

deploy-bot: canary deployment started for fix/sdk-route-normalize on staging; build 537. ETA ~12m :rocket: 

eng-sdk: assigned. We'll prioritize backport to 0.23.x patch once validated. ETA ~2h for canary + patch release. Will update here.

elaine: sending workaround to customer and will keep them updated. thanks :heart: 

mike: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/412 — if canary looks good we'll publish 0.23.1 and update changelog.

support-oncall: marking incident P2 -> workaround provided. customer notified.

elaine: thanks everyone — closing once release is published.
